scripts.test: (cd app/agent && bun run build) && cd app && for f in test/*.test.ts; do bun test "$f" || exit 1; done && cd agent && for f in test/*.test.ts src/harnesses/*/*.test.ts; do bun test "$f" || exit 1; done && cd ../../native && bun test
scripts.agent:test: cd app/agent && bun run build && bun test
scripts.test:agent-proofs: (cd app/agent && bun run build) && cd app && for f in test/agent-session-pi-proof.test.ts test/agent-session-codex-proof.test.ts; do SLIRC_AGENT_PROOFS=true bun test "$f" || exit 1; done && cd agent && SLIRC_AGENT_PROOFS=true bun test src/harnesses/codex/runtime.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-e2e: cd app && SLIRC_REQUIRE_PI=true bun test test/agent-session-pi-proof.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-browser-e2e: cd app && SLIRC_PI_BROWSER_E2E=true bun test test/e2e-agent-pi-browser.test.ts
